description: Typical listed prices for a spec (carat size, colour, clarity, shape, origin) across all retailers Carat Hunter tracks, with the day they were measured, as its insights page shows them: stones with a recently confirmed price, their median and typical range (10th to 90th percentile), how many retailers list them, and how much the same certified stone typically varies between retailers. Carat sizes: 0.3, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5 (each the start of a range: 1 covers 1.00 to 1.49ct).
name: price_check
title: Market price for a diamond spec
